endpoints.name: PTree.Regression.Probability.RelationalLimit.mathcomp_coherent_joint_limit
endpoints.type:
RelationalLimit.mathcomp_coherent_joint_limit
     : forall R : reals.Real.type,
       Kernel.MathCompCouplingGluing R ->
       forall (A B : Type) (T : A -> B -> Prop) (c : nat -> Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R A)
         (d : nat -> Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R B)
         (j : nat -> Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R (A * B))
         (mu : Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R A) (nu : Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R B),
       @Omega.sem_increasing (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
         (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticOmega R)
         (A * B) j ->
       @Omega.sem_lub (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R)
         (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticOmega R) A c mu ->
       @Omega.sem_lub (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R)
         (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticOmega R) B d nu ->
       (forall n : nat,
        @Measure.sem_eq (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R) A
          (@Measure.sem_bind (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
             (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R) (A * B) A (j n)
             (fun p : A * B =>
              @Measure.sem_ret (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
                (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R) A (@fst A B p)))
          (c n)) ->
       (forall n : nat,
        @Measure.sem_eq (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R) B
          (@Measure.sem_bind (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
             (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R) (A * B) B (j n)
             (fun p : A * B =>
              @Measure.sem_ret (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
                (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R) B (@snd A B p)))
          (d n)) ->
       (forall n : nat,
        @Measure.sem_ae (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R)
          (A * B) (j n) (fun p : A * B => T (@fst A B p) (@snd A B p))) ->
       @Measure.sem_lift (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R) A
         B T mu nu
endpoints.assumptions:
Axioms:
boolp.propositional_extensionality : forall P Q : Prop, P <-> Q -> P = Q
boolp.functional_extensionality_dep :
  forall (A : Type) (B : A -> Type) (f g : forall x : A, B x), (forall x : A, f x = g x) -> f = g
boolp.constructive_indefinite_description :
  forall (A : Type) (P : A -> Prop), (exists x : A, P x) -> {x : A | P x}
